attacks.claim: The retry loop generates a new client_order_id on every attempt. A timeout on attempt 1 can still reach the broker, so attempt 2 submits the same order under a different ID. The broker's dedupe on client_order_id cannot catch that, so the duplicate-fill risk the PR says is ruled out is live.
attacks.evidence: for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) { const clientOrderId = randomUUID(); try { const res = await broker.post(... client_order_id: clientOrderId ...)
